details:
Our team, Dev Squad, stood out by tackling the challenge from a tactile perspective. While many submissions rely purely on screens and essays, we focused on physical engagement to make space science accessible, playful, and immersive. Our team carefully considered user experience, safety, and intuitive design to ensure participants of all ages could jump right into training. Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer, is a physical interactive mission training experience designed for aspiring astronauts and users of all ages. Instead of a traditional, static essay, we brought astronaut mental preparation to life in a physical form, turning cognitive and IQ challenges into an engaging, hands-on training module that simulates real astronaut readiness tasks.

We developed the prototype using Python and JavaScript.
